collection.name: daCAT World Physical Companions
collection.note: Umbrella for physical + NFT pairs. Founders Edition is the first series (max 20). Stewarded by dacatworld.eth.
collection.contract_name: DACAT WORLD FOUNDERS EDITION 3D PRINTED COLLECTIBLE FIGURES

items.name: DACAT WORLD Founders Edition
items.description:
DACAT WORLD Founders Edition — 3D Printed Collectible Figures.

Step into DACAT WORLD with the Founders Edition physical + NFT pair. Created by Russell Corey, each NFT is the digital companion to a numbered physical figure (1 of 20 through 20 of 20). Artwork shows the carded figure and packaging with Founders Edition branding.

items.name: DACAT WORLD Founders Edition #1
items.description:
DACAT WORLD #1 of 20 FOUNDERS EDITION 

Step into DACAT WORLD with the 3D Printed Collectible Figure Founders Edition. Created by Russell Corey, this NFT artwork is the digital companion to a collection of the first 20 numbered physical figures. Each artwork features the carded figure and its packaging, with Founders Edition branding and an edition number from 1 of 20 through 20 of 20. Together, the figure and artwork bring a piece of the DACAT WORLD entertainment universe into collectible form. Explore a world of comics, characters, games, and 3D printed collectibles, where stories take shape on the page, on screens, and on your shelf. The Founders Edition celebrates that creative spirit through a small physical run and its accompanying digital artwork. Whether you connect with the character, the packaging, or the world behind it, this collection offers a glimpse into Russell Corey's expanding creative universe. Welcome to DACAT WORLD.
